F006.summary: Database package with Drizzle ORM is fully configured with SQLite/libsql, drizzle.config.ts, schema files, and migration system

Drizzle ORM configured with SQLite.detail: drizzle.config.ts configures dialect: 'turso' (libsql). Dependencies: drizzle-orm@0.45.1, @libsql/client, libsql. db/src/index.ts creates drizzle client with libsql.

drizzle.config.ts present.detail: Full config with schema path, migrations output dir, DATABASE_URL validation, multi-path .env loading.

Initial schema file created.detail: packages/db/src/schema/index.ts re-exports from 10 schema modules: auth, events, features, learnings, messages, notifications, projects, sessions, settings, worktrees.

Migration system setup.detail: packages/db/src/migrate.ts has runMigrations() that auto-backs up DB, then runs drizzle-orm/libsql/migrator. 7 migration SQL files exist (0000-0006). Also has backupDatabase() and rollbackDatabase() for safety.

F007.summary: Projects table has all required columns, primary key, unique constraint (composite with userId), and JSON settings

Table created with all columns.detail: project table has id, userId, name, path, settings, status, createdAt, updatedAt. All columns properly typed.

Unique constraint on path.detail: Unique constraint is composite: uniqueIndex('project_user_path_unique').on(table.userId, table.path). AC says 'unique on path' but composite with userId is better for multi-user. Functionally exceeds AC.

JSON column for flexible settings.detail: settings: text('settings', { mode: 'json' }).$type<Record<string, unknown>>() with sensible defaults.

F008.summary: Features table comprehensively maps all Feature fields to columns with FK, indexes, and JSON fields for complex types

All feature fields mapped to columns.detail: ~40 columns mapping all Feature Zod schema fields including required (id, title, category, description, phase, status, passes, acceptanceCriteria) and optional (model, thinkingLevel, planningMode, etc.). F258 additions included (useWorktree, locked, lockedBy, pipelineStep, etc.).

F009.summary: Sessions table (agent_session) has lifecycle columns, FK to features, TEXT output, and proper indexes

Session lifecycle columns present.detail: Table has: id, userId, featureId, projectId, status, startedAt, completedAt, output, error. Plus F258 additions: sdkSessionId, model, isRunning, workingDirectory, messageCount.

Foreign key to features table.detail: featureId: text('feature_id').references(() => feature.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }). Also has Drizzle relations defined for type-safe queries.

Output stored as TEXT (large content).detail: output: text('output'). SQLite TEXT type has no practical size limit.

Index on status and featureId.detail: Two separate indexes: agent_session_status_idx on status, agent_session_feature_id_idx on featureId.

F010.summary: Learning table stores patterns with metadata, category indexing, source featureId tracking, and timestamps

Learnings stored with metadata.detail: learning table has: id, userId, featureId, category, pattern, antiPattern, context (JSON with problem/solution/codeExample/gotcha/recommendation), severity, tags (JSON array), timestamps.

Source featureId tracked.detail: featureId: text('feature_id').references(() => feature.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }). Uses set null instead of cascade so learnings persist even if feature is deleted.

Timestamp for recency.detail: createdAt and updatedAt as integer('timestamp_ms') with auto-defaults using unixepoch. updatedAt has $onUpdate trigger.
